UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated cybersecurity operator profile stored in Firestore

uid.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID of the operator

photoURL.description: Profile picture URL from Google Auth

TopologyDesign.description: Saved defensive network topology architecture created by an operator

metadata.description: Key telemetry counters and authorship attributes
